You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0001.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m)); print(Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 print(a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),[n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetNeighbors()],a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '')

cat > /tmp/build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
s='CC(=O)C1CCC2C3CCC4=CC(=O)CCC4(C)C3CCC12C'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(s))
xy={0:(891,116),1:(817,131),2:(745,52),3:(785,248),4:(856,346),5:(787,463),6:(673,405),7:(569,465),8:(569,585),9:(465,645),10:(360,585),11:(257,644),12:(152,585),13:(43,645),14:(152,465),15:(257,405),16:(360,465),17:(360,355),18:(464,405),19:(464,286),20:(569,225),21:(673,286),22:(673,175)}
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i,(x,y) in xy.items():conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x/100.,-y/100.,0))
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.GetSymbol()=='H':
  idx=a.GetIdx(); parent=a.GetNeighbors()[0].GetIdx()
  if parent in [6,7,18]:
   x,y={6:(673,510),7:(569,350),18:(464,510)}[parent]
  else:
   x,y=xy[parent]; x+=40+(idx%3)*15; y+=25+(idx%4)*10
  conf.SetAtomPosition(idx,Point3D(x/100.,-y/100.,0))
m.AddConformer(conf)
for idx,neighbor,dir in [(3,1,Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE),(16,17,Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE),(21,22,Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)]:
 m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(idx,neighbor).SetBondDir(dir)
for idx,dir in [(6,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH),(7,Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE),(18,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)]:
 h=next(a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx).GetNeighbors() if a.GetSymbol()=='H')
 m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(idx,h).SetBondDir(dir)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.GetChiralTag()!=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED:print(a.GetIdx(),a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else 'none')
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,randomSeed=27)
res=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1000)
print('mmff',res)
from rdkit.Chem import rdMolDescriptors
print(rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nProgesterone, stereochemistry reconstructed from 2D drawing; MMFF94 optimized\n')
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx());f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .7f} {p.y: .7f} {p.z: .7f}\n')
PY

cat > /tmp/construct_steroid.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

# Wedges and dashes of the supplied steroid drawing, including the acetyl and ring-junction substituents.
smiles='CC(=O)[C@H]1CC[C@H]2[C@@H]3CCC4=CC(=O)CC[C@]4(C)[C@H]3CC[C@]12C'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles))
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3()
params.randomSeed=93
assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, params)==0
assert AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1000)==0
with open('answer.xyz','w') as out:
    out.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nSteroid 4-ene-3,20-dione, MMFF94 optimized; hydrogens explicit\n')
    conf=m.GetConformer()
    for atom in m.GetAtoms():
        p=conf.GetAtomPosition(atom.GetIdx())
        out.write(f'{atom.GetSymbol():2} {p.x:.8f} {p.y:.8f} {p.z:.8f}\n')
PY
python /tmp/construct_steroid.py
head -3 answer.xyz; wc -l answer.xyz
